sentences.zh: 好吧，现在有很多人们享受圣诞节的场景。

sentences.en: Everyone's getting gifts that are really meaningful to them.
sentences.zh: 每个人都收到了对自己意义非凡的礼物。

sentences.en: And finally, Dwight is going to get the last piece of his gift and realizes this whole time he's been making a nutcracker.
sentences.zh: 最后，德怀特拿到了礼物的最后一部分，才意识到他这一整天都在组装一个胡桃夹子。

sentences.en: Yes, of course.
sentences.zh: 是的，当然。

sentences.en: It's like a really cool nutcracker.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常酷的胡桃夹子。

sentences.en: We had a fan question from Lacey L.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一位粉丝莱西·L的提问，

sentences.en: in Grand Prairie, Texas.
sentences.zh: 她来自德克萨斯州的大草原城。

sentences.en: Please, please tell me about Dwight's nutcracker.
sentences.zh: 求求你，一定要告诉我关于德怀特那个胡桃夹子的事。

sentences.en: Who came up with it?
sentences.zh: 是谁想出来的？

sentences.en: Where did they find it?
sentences.zh: 他们是在哪儿找到的？

sentences.en: Or did they have to create it?
sentences.zh: 还是说他们必须得亲手制作？

sentences.en: I have been looking for it for years.
sentences.zh: 我找这个东西找了好多年了。

sentences.en: Lacey, I thought the same thing.
sentences.zh: 莱西，我当时也是这么想的。

sentences.en: I thought, can I get one of these?
sentences.zh: 我在想，我能买到一个吗？

sentences.en: Well, Randy told me that this was not in the first shooting draft of the script.
sentences.zh: 兰迪告诉我，这在剧本的初稿里是没有的。

sentences.en: This whole runner was added later.
sentences.zh: 整个这个桥段是后来加进去的。

sentences.en: And he believes that it was the master of the cold opens, Aaron Schur, who wrote this story arc.
sentences.zh: 他认为，是“开场戏大师”亚伦·舒尔写了这个故事线。

sentences.en: Because Aaron became the point person that they went to to discuss the creation of this prop.
sentences.zh: 因为亚伦成了他们讨论这个道具制作时的对接人。

sentences.en: Randy said when he and Phil first read this story arc,
sentences.zh: 兰迪说，当他和菲尔第一次读到这个故事线时，

sentences.en: they assumed that this contraption was something the writers had seen on the internet somewhere.
sentences.zh: 他们以为这个装置是编剧们在网上哪里看到过的东西。

sentences.en: And they wanted to know where do they buy it.
sentences.zh: 他们想知道去哪儿能买到。

sentences.en: It turns out, Ange, it did not exist anywhere.
sentences.zh: 结果呢，安吉，这东西根本就不存在。

sentences.en: They made it up?
sentences.zh: 他们编出来的？

sentences.en: Yeah, they made it up.
sentences.zh: 没错，他们编出来的。

sentences.en: I even went to the rewrite of the script, and there is no scripted description of this machine.
sentences.zh: 我甚至去查了剧本的重写稿，上面对这个机器没有任何剧本描述。

sentences.en: So Phil needed to conceptualize, design, and build a working nutcracker prop
sentences.zh: 所以菲尔需要构思、设计并制造一个能用的胡桃夹子道具，

sentences.en: that looked like it could have been a gun, and he had less than a week to do it.
sentences.zh: 看起来还得像把枪，而且他只有不到一周的时间。

sentences.en: Phil Shea.
sentences.zh: 菲尔·谢伊。

sentences.en: This is why he was always running, folks.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么他总是行色匆匆，伙计们。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Phil went to his go-to props manufacturing house, the hand prop room.
sentences.zh: 菲尔去了他常去的道具制造厂——手持道具室。

sentences.en: The team at that facility, Randy said, was understandably freaked out at the very short
sentences.zh: 兰迪说，那里的团队对他们要在如此短的时间内

sentences.en: time span that they had to create this prop.
sentences.zh: 制作出这个道具感到非常抓狂，这是可以理解的。

sentences.en: They told Phil to tell Randy to open up the company checkbook.
sentences.zh: 他们让菲尔告诉兰迪，准备好公司的支票簿。

sentences.en: They were going to have to put a full team of engineers and builders basically around
sentences.zh: 他们必须安排一整队工程师和建造师基本上

sentences.en: the clock to get this done in time.
sentences.zh: 全天候赶工才能按时完成。

sentences.en: Randy said to their credit, they did a masterful job.
sentences.zh: 兰迪说，值得称赞的是，他们完成得非常出色。

sentences.en: All in, this prop cost about $19,000.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这个道具花了大约19000美元。

sentences.en: Also, it was a one-off.
sentences.zh: 而且，它是独一无二的。

sentences.en: He said, to the best of his knowledge, the NBC Universal marketing people never made replicas
sentences.zh: 他说，据他所知，NBC环球的营销部门从未制作过

sentences.en: of this for online sales.
sentences.zh: 这个道具的复制品进行在线销售。

sentences.en: They should have.
sentences.zh: 他们本该做的。

sentences.en: They still can.
sentences.zh: 他们依然可以。

sentences.en: I'm just saying, this would be a hot item at the holidays.
sentences.zh: 我只是说，这在节日期间会是个抢手货。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Do you know how many people would buy this?
sentences.zh: 你知道会有多少人买这个吗？

sentences.en: I would.
sentences.zh: 我会买。

sentences.en: I would, too.
sentences.zh: 我也会买。

sentences.en: But do I have to put it together?
sentences.zh: 但我得自己组装吗？

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不用。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不用。

sentences.en: What if you do?
sentences.zh: 要是你非要组装呢？

sentences.en: That would be the ultimate.
sentences.zh: 那可就太极致了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: You know, this story reminds me of something that I had a makeup artist tell me once.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这个故事让我想起了一位化妆师曾经对我说过的话。

sentences.en: She said, there is a saying in this business.
sentences.zh: 她说，这行里有句老话。

sentences.en: It's called fast, cheap, or good.
sentences.zh: 叫作：快、廉、优。

sentences.en: And you can only have two of the three things.
sentences.zh: 你只能三选二。

sentences.en: It can be fast and cheap, but it's not going to look good.
sentences.zh: 可以又快又廉，但看起来不会好。

sentences.en: It can be cheap and good, but it's not going to be faSt.
sentences.zh: 可以又廉又优，但不会快。

sentences.en: If you want it to be both fast and good, it's not going to be cheap.
sentences.zh: 如果你想要又快又优，那就不可能廉价。

sentences.en: And that was the case with our nutcracker.
sentences.zh: 我们的胡桃夹子就是这种情况。

sentences.en: Fast and good.
sentences.zh: 又快又好。

sentences.en: It was not cheap.
sentences.zh: 它可不便宜。

sentences.en: Not going to be cheap.
sentences.zh: 不可能便宜的。

sentences.en: Nope.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, Jenna, Mindy also spoke about this scene on the commentary, and she said it was a last-minute rewrite, that it was not in her original draft.
sentences.zh: 嗯，珍娜，敏迪在评论音轨里也提到了这一幕，她说这是临时改写的，原稿里并没有。

sentences.en: She said it was written by Aaron Schur and Charlie Grandy, and Mindy said Phil Shea went above and beyond, especially because it was a last-minute prop gag.
sentences.zh: 她说这是亚伦·舒尔和查理·格兰迪写的，敏迪还说菲尔·谢做得非常出色，尤其是考虑到这只是个临时的道具笑料。

sentences.en: She also commented that it was a note from Greg to add a Dwight-Michael storyline to this episode, and it pays off so nicely at the end.
sentences.zh: 她还评论说，是格雷格提议在这集里加入一条德怀特和迈克尔的故事线，最后的效果确实非常棒。

sentences.en: It's a moment of redemption for Michael.
sentences.zh: 这对迈克尔来说是一个救赎的时刻。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah, he knows Dwight so well.
sentences.zh: 没错，他太了解德怀特了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: It's a good note.
sentences.zh: 这是个好建议。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, the party is wrapping up.
sentences.zh: 好了，派对要结束了。

sentences.en: Everyone is leaving for the night.
sentences.zh: 大家都要回家了。

sentences.en: They're walking out into the parking lot.
sentences.zh: 他们正走向停车场。

sentences.en: There's snow.
sentences.zh: 外面在下雪。

sentences.en: It feels so Christmassy and festive.
sentences.zh: 感觉非常有圣诞气氛，很喜庆。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You know, as you're walking out, Angela, I don't know if you noticed this, but we got a fan question from Kelsey D in Orlando, Florida.
sentences.zh: 你知道，安吉拉，当你走出去的时候，我不知道你有没有注意到，我们收到了佛罗里达州奥兰多市凯尔西·D发来的粉丝提问。

sentences.en: I noticed when everyone is leaving the office, Angela slips, and Daryl is there to help her.
sentences.zh: 我注意到大家离开办公室时，安吉拉滑倒了，达里尔在那儿扶了她一把。

sentences.en: Did Angela actually slip, or was that planned?
sentences.zh: 安吉拉是真的滑倒了，还是那是安排好的？

sentences.en: Because I love that moment.
sentences.zh: 因为我太喜欢那一幕了。

sentences.en: It's so cute and sweet between Angela and Daryl.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉和达里尔之间的互动太可爱、太甜蜜了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Kelsey, I did actually trip.
sentences.zh: 凯尔西，我确实是真的绊倒了。

sentences.en: And I grabbed Craig's arm.
sentences.zh: 我抓住了克雷格的胳膊。

sentences.en: So that quick moment you're seeing, that's us.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到的那个瞬间，是我们真实的反应。

sentences.en: Aw.
sentences.zh: 噢。

sentences.en: We're not in character.
sentences.zh: 我们当时没在演戏。

sentences.en: And I think Rain must have seen it and improvised the line as Dwight, watch out, it's slippery out here.
sentences.zh: 我想雷恩一定是看到了，于是即兴加了那句“德怀特，小心点，外面很滑”。

sentences.en: Because that line is not in the shooting draft.
sentences.zh: 因为剧本初稿里并没有那句台词。

sentences.en: Me slipping and tripping is obviously not in the shooting draft.
sentences.zh: 我滑倒和绊倒的镜头显然也不在剧本初稿里。

sentences.en: So, yes, that's just me and Craig.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，那纯粹是我和克雷格的即兴发挥。

sentences.en: And thank goodness he was there, because I guess I turned my ankle or something.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地当时他在场，因为我好像扭到脚踝之类的了。

sentences.en: Well, all of a sudden we hear something.
sentences.zh: 突然间，我们听到了一些声音。

sentences.en: It's drummers.
sentences.zh: 是鼓手们。

sentences.en: It's 12 drummers drumming!
sentences.zh: 是十二个击鼓的鼓手！

sentences.en: This is Aaron's final Christmas present from Andy.
sentences.zh: 这是安迪送给艾琳的最后一份圣诞礼物。

sentences.en: Andy is on the cymbals.
sentences.zh: 安迪在打镲。

sentences.en: He starts dancing.
sentences.zh: 他开始跳舞了。

sentences.en: It's so festive.
sentences.zh: 真是太有节日气氛了。

sentences.en: We had a fan catch from Rachel I in Phoenix, Arizona, who said,
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一位来自亚利桑那州凤凰城的粉丝瑞秋·I的提问，她说：

sentences.en: There are only 11 people in the drumline.
sentences.zh: 鼓乐队里只有11个人。

sentences.en: Was Andy meant to be the 12th person?
sentences.zh: 安迪原本应该是第12个人吗？

sentences.en: Yes, Rachel, he was the 12th percussionist in this drumline.
sentences.zh: 是的，瑞秋，他确实是这支鼓乐队里的第12位打击乐手。

sentences.en: We also got a question from Maria S in Austin, Texas, who asked,
sentences.zh: 我们还收到了来自德克萨斯州奥斯汀的玛丽亚·S的提问，她问：

sentences.en: What was the process for choosing this group that played the 12 drummers drumming?
sentences.zh: 挑选这支表演“十二个击鼓的鼓手”的团队的过程是怎样的？

sentences.en: And Emily B.
sentences.zh: 还有来自加利福尼亚州托伦斯的艾米丽·B

sentences.en: from Torrance, California, said,
sentences.zh: 说道：

sentences.en: I want to give a shout-out to the RCC Marching Tigers,
sentences.zh: 我想为RCC行进老虎队点个赞，

sentences.en: who are the drumline featured in this episode.
sentences.zh: 他们就是本集中出镜的鼓乐队。

sentences.en: RCC has a fall marching band program and also a winter percussion program
sentences.zh: RCC不仅有秋季行进乐队项目，还有一个冬季打击乐项目，

sentences.en: that is one of the best independent performance groups in the country.
sentences.zh: 是全国最优秀的独立表演团体之一。

sentences.en: You can see more about them at rccdrums on IG.
sentences.zh: 你们可以在Instagram上关注rccdrums了解更多关于他们的信息。

sentences.en: She said,
sentences.zh: 她说：

sentences.en: My husband is the battery captain head and a ranger for the group,
sentences.zh: 我丈夫是该团体的打击乐队长和编曲，

sentences.en: which means he writes the music and teaches the students how to play their instruments.
sentences.zh: 这意味着他负责写谱并教学生们如何演奏乐器。

sentences.en: So it is always so fun when I see RCC on a show.
sentences.zh: 所以每次在节目里看到RCC，我都觉得特别开心。

sentences.en: They've been on Parks and Rec, too.
sentences.zh: 他们也上过《公园与游憩》。

sentences.en: Emily, thank you so much for sending that in.
sentences.zh: 艾米丽，非常感谢你发来这些信息。

sentences.en: Randy confirmed that everything Emily said is correct.
sentences.zh: 兰迪证实了艾米丽所说的一切都是正确的。

sentences.en: He said that he would always reach out to a woman named Christine Day.
sentences.zh: 他说他总是会联系一位叫克里斯汀·戴的女士。

sentences.en: She is a music contractor.
sentences.zh: 她是一位音乐承包商。

sentences.en: And she finds musical on-screen performers.
sentences.zh: 她负责寻找荧幕上的音乐表演者。

sentences.en: Randy said there was just no one better than her.
sentences.zh: 兰迪说没有人比她更出色了。

sentences.en: He actually said, quote,
sentences.zh: 他甚至引用原话说道：

sentences.en: She is well known across the industry for her cheerful professionalism and ability to grasp the essence of a script
sentences.zh: 她在业内以其愉快的专业精神和对剧本精髓的把握能力而闻名，

sentences.en: and the showrunner's intent.
sentences.zh: 同时也深谙剧集主创的意图。

sentences.en: All in, including Christine's fee, the marching band cost us $9,950.
sentences.zh: 算上克里斯汀的费用，这支行进乐队总共花费了我们9950美元。

sentences.en: Well, I will put the RCC Drums Instagram in our story so you guys can see what they're up to.
sentences.zh: 我会把RCC鼓乐队的Instagram账号放到我们的快拍里，这样你们就能看到他们的动态了。

sentences.en: I loved learning all of that.
sentences.zh: 了解这些幕后故事我真的很开心。

sentences.en: Well, we had so much fun on this night with this marching band.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上和这支行进乐队在一起我们玩得非常开心。

sentences.en: I'll never forget it.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记那一晚。

sentences.en: I mean, we got to stay late.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我们那天留到了很晚。

sentences.en: We always love to stay late.
sentences.zh: 我们总是很喜欢留到很晚。

sentences.en: We did it so rarely.
sentences.zh: 这种情况太少见了。

sentences.en: And then we had snow.
sentences.zh: 而且当时还下着雪。

sentences.en: We had snow with this, like, amazing drumming as a backdrop.
sentences.zh: 在漫天飞雪和这令人惊叹的鼓声背景下，

sentences.en: Incredible.
sentences.zh: 太不可思议了。

sentences.en: I asked Randy if we used snow business again.
sentences.zh: 我问了兰迪我们是不是又用了造雪公司。

sentences.en: And he said, no, not this time.
sentences.zh: 他说，没有，这次没用。

sentences.en: It was Ron Neri's group, ANA Special Effects in Van Nuys.
sentences.zh: 是罗恩·内里的团队，位于范奈斯的ANA特效公司。

sentences.en: He said, in order to get that snow in our parking lot, they had to call this place Union Ice in North Hollywood,
sentences.zh: 他说，为了在我们的停车场弄出那些雪，他们不得不联系北好莱坞的一家叫联合制冰的公司，

sentences.en: and they brought two semi-tractor trailer rigs full of ice.
sentences.zh: 然后他们拉了两辆装满冰块的半挂卡车过来。

sentences.en: Two!
sentences.zh: 两辆！

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then Ron's team put the ice through an industrial chipper, and it, like, shot it into the air.
sentences.zh: 然后罗恩的团队把冰块放进工业碎冰机里，就像这样，把它喷射到空中。

sentences.en: He said, we shot that scene on a Friday night, and it had been 78 degrees that day.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们是在周五晚上拍的那场戏，那天有78华氏度（约25.5摄氏度）。

sentences.en: He said, all of the snow effects for this episode, filling the parking lot as well as that little snowfall behind our windows,
sentences.zh: 他说，这一集所有的雪景特效，包括填满停车场以及窗外那场小雪，

sentences.en: that cost $36,000 for snow.
sentences.zh: 光雪就花了36000美元。

sentences.en: For snow on a day where it was almost 80 degrees.
sentences.zh: 在气温接近80华氏度（约26.7摄氏度）的日子里，为了这些雪。

sentences.en: You know, it's always fascinating to me when Randy shares with us how much something cost in an episode because it's like—
sentences.zh: 你知道，每当兰迪和我们分享某一集里某样东西花了多少钱时，我总是觉得很着迷，因为这就像是——

sentences.en: He had to budget all of that.
sentences.zh: 他必须把所有这些都算进预算里。

sentences.en: Yeah, and the budget for each episode does not change.
sentences.zh: 没错，而且每一集的预算都是固定的。

sentences.en: It doesn't change week to week, but the demands change.
sentences.zh: 每周的预算不会变，但需求却在变。

sentences.en: So he would have this elaborate spreadsheet, and he would have to figure out how to make all these little details happen.
sentences.zh: 所以他会有一张复杂的电子表格，他必须想办法把所有这些小细节都实现。

sentences.en: He needed to get the geese and the swans and the special prop and the snow and the drumline
sentences.zh: 他需要找来鹅、天鹅、特殊的道具、雪还有鼓乐队，

sentences.en: and make it all cost the same as an episode that didn't even have all those things.
sentences.zh: 还要让这一切的成本和那些根本没有这些东西的一集保持一致。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's really fascinating to me.
sentences.zh: 这真的让我觉得很着迷。

sentences.en: But you know I love a spreadsheet.
sentences.zh: 但你知道我喜欢电子表格。

sentences.en: I know you do.
sentences.zh: 我知道你喜欢。

sentences.en: Well, you know, Mindy was talking in the commentary about the scene about how hard Ed had to work as Andy doing the running man dancing with the cymbals.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，明迪在评论音轨里谈到那场戏时，说艾德在演安迪时有多辛苦，要一边跳“跑男舞”一边敲镲。

sentences.en: And we did a lot of takes, and she was like, do you guys remember?
sentences.zh: 我们拍了很多条，她当时就问，你们记得吗？

sentences.en: He was, like, sweating.
sentences.zh: 他当时满头大汗。

sentences.en: He did such a good job.
sentences.zh: 他做得真好。
